P.text: A user or contract calls transferFrom to move tokens on behalf of another address using an allowance; the TokenWrapper contract implements the IERC20 interface.
P.evidence_quote: When a user or contract calls `transferFrom` to move tokens on behalf of another address using an allowance

I.text: Per ERC-20/EIP-20, the Transfer event must emit the address of the token holder whose balance decreases as the from parameter.
I.evidence_quote: According to the ERC-20 standard as defined in EIP-20, the Transfer event must emit the address of the token holder whose balance decreases as the from parameter.

V.text: The transferFrom function emits msg.sender (the spender) instead of the from parameter in the Transfer event, while internal balances are updated correctly.
V.evidence_quote: the emitted Transfer event incorrectly identifies the transaction initiator (msg.sender, the spender) as the source of the tokens, rather than the actual token holder (the from parameter) whose balance is being debited.
